Beyond the standard profile

You already know how to collect, store, convert, calculate and display data. These operations introduce three more powerful techniques that let you extract, protect and process intelligence.

⚠ OPERATIONAL RULES

These challenges are deliberately less guided than standard training.

  • Use the examples as patterns, not as code to copy without thinking.
  • Run small sections often.
  • Check variable names, quotation marks, brackets and indentation.
  • Only mark a task complete after the program runs and its output matches the brief.

FINAL CLASSIFIED BRIEF
Create a sanitised agent dossier
Your program must transform a raw intelligence signal into a safe final dossier.
  1. Store the signal XX_ECHO_27_CLEAR.
  2. Use slicing to extract codename ECHO and clearance 27.
  3. Ask for a mission report and a sensitive word.
  4. Replace the sensitive word with █████.
  5. Ask for hours worked and hourly rate.
  6. Calculate gross pay, 20% security tax and net pay.
  7. Print one clearly labelled sanitised dossier.
▸ Example output
=== SANITISED AGENT DOSSIER ===
Codename: ECHO
Clearance: 27
Report: Agent █████ secured the terminal.
Gross pay: £120.00
Security tax: £24.00
Net pay: £96.00
